claims.claim_summary: LibreEvolve is alpha-stage, local, Python-first research code and not a production optimizer or full AlphaEvolve reproduction.

README runnable-today bullets describe task-primary bounded text workspaces with optional local candidate runners, SEARCH/REPLACE mutations, configured provider backends, local MAP-Elites/island archives, local evaluation, hooks, and runs/ artifacts.

README important limits keep AlphaEvolve-scale benchmarks, Google/Gemini parity, distributed async topology, real-language toolchain parity, hardened sandboxing, and paper-cache claims scoped as missing or non-proof evidence.
ROADMAP current-state bullets are maintained planning summaries whose authoritative evidence remains code, tests, runtime artifacts, paper sidecars, and TODO ledgers.
ROADMAP documentation-truthfulness status records path, manifest, TODO-coverage, and sidecar-registry guards while leaving semantic claim-by-claim proof open.
ROADMAP missing-work sections preserve AlphaEvolve parity gaps instead of treating local validators, sidecars, or fixtures as full paper-result reproduction.
The papers README describes the local cache manifests, ignored PDF policy, retained AlphaEvolve source-artifact exception, rehydration command, and manifest validation boundaries.
The papers README implementation-status table is a maintained public claim surface with structural validation and TODO linkage, but not a semantic proof ledger for every long status phrase.

claim_boundary: This inventory gives stable ids and evidence anchors for the top-level README, ROADMAP, and papers index AlphaEvolve-facing status claims, including source-anchor file offsets for those top-level claim surfaces and local evidence-ref existence records. Fragment-bearing evidence refs also record exact Markdown heading anchor resolution, and audited surface headings are enumerated for the README, ROADMAP, and papers index with explicit heading-to-claim coverage records. It also records a structural docs/status.md ledger inventory for implemented-today and important-limits bullets, including bullet spans, hashes, status-signal terms, and local backtick path existence records. It records a structural run-artifacts guide inventory that compares top-level documented run outputs with the current overwrite cleanup artifact set. It does not claim complete README coverage, complete ROADMAP coverage, complete papers index coverage, semantic docs/status.md freshness, complete run-artifact lifecycle proof, semantic claim verification, stale completed-entry detection, generated alignment reports, or full proof that every documentation claim is current.
